notes.title: Update 0.1.03
notes.content:
Update 0.1.03 is now live.  

- Added the keyboard overlays to the egg progression in mode 4.

- Updated some of the art assets.

- Bug fixes

tags.feature: - Added the keyboard overlays to the egg progression in mode 4.

notes.title: Update 0.1.02
notes.content: Thank you for enjoying the game. We have had requests for adding keyboard support. So in this update we have done that. All modes can now be played with a keyboard. However we are still working on the overlays for game mode 4 egg progression. Also in this update are bug fixes and rating updates. Thanks again for playing and sending us feedback while we work through early access.
